model.src:
(block System
  :type "Module"
  (sketch "A randomly generated system for testing layout rules.")
  (shape Request (sketch "A request."))
  (shape Event (sketch "A event."))
  (shape Snapshot (sketch "A snapshot."))
  (shape Command (sketch "A command."))
  (shape Receipt (sketch "A receipt."))
  (behavior Durable (port :in Event :as keep) (sketch "Retains events until acknowledged."))
  (behavior Observable (port :out Snapshot :as metric) (sketch "Reports its own health."))
  (level
    (adjacent
      (block ShadowLedger :type "Store"
        (sketch "Keeps the latest state per key."))
      (block ShadowBilling
        (takes Receipt :as req)
        (sketch "Retries failed deliveries with backoff, then parks them for a human to look at."))
      (block RemoteIndex :type "Process"
        (takes Event)
        (sketch "Turns raw input into typed commands and rejects anything malformed before it reaches storage."))
      (block RemoteSync
        (sketch "Retries failed deliveries with backoff, then parks them for a human to look at.")))
    (adjacent
      (block RetryPricing
        (takes Receipt :as req)
        (gives Command)
        (sketch "Fans out each event to every subscriber that asked for its kind."))
      (block LiveEditor
        (gives Request :as done)
        (sketch "Retries failed deliveries with backoff, then parks them for a human to look at.")
        (level
          (adjacent
            (block Queue
              (takes Request :as evt)
              (sketch "Fans out each event to every subscriber that asked for its kind."))
            (block LiveMetrics
              (implements Durable)
              (sketch "Draws the list and only mounts what is on screen."))
            (block EdgeSearch :type "Service"
              (sketch "Turns raw input into typed commands and rejects anything malformed before it reaches storage."))
            (block Editor
              (sketch "Thin wrapper.")))
          (block LiveRouter
            (sketch "Keeps the latest state per key.")))
        (level
          (adjacent
            (block BatchAuth
              (sketch "Fans out each event to every subscriber that asked for its kind."))
            (block ShadowEditor
              (sketch "Keeps the latest state per key.")
              (level
                (adjacent
                  (block RemoteGateway
                    (sketch "Retries failed deliveries with backoff, then parks them for a human to look at."))
                  (block RemoteLedger
                    (gives Command :as done)
                    (implements Durable)
                    (sketch "Thin wrapper."))
                  (block LivePlanner :type "Process"
                    (gives Receipt :as emit)
                    (sketch "Thin wrapper."))
                  (block LocalProfile
                    (sketch "Fans out each event to every subscriber that asked for its kind.")))
                (adjacent
                  (block ShadowGateway
                    (implements Observable)
                    (sketch "Thin wrapper."))
                  (block LocalRenderer
                    (takes Request)
                    (sketch "Turns raw input into typed commands and rejects anything malformed before it reaches storage.")))))
            (block RemoteMetrics
              (takes Snapshot :as evt)
              (gives Command :as done)
              (sketch "Fans out each event to every subscriber that asked for its kind."))
            (block Scheduler :type "Feature"
              (gives Snapshot)
              (implements Durable)
              (sketch "Thin wrapper.")))
          (block LocalQueue
            (takes Receipt :as req)
            (sketch "Thin wrapper."))
          (block ShadowAuth :type "Feature"
            (takes Snapshot)
            (sketch "Fans out each event to every subscriber that asked for its kind.")
            (level
              (block LocalLedger
                (sketch "Keeps the latest state per key."))
              (adjacent
                (block Search
                  (takes Receipt :as evt)
                  (implements Durable)
                  (sketch "Draws the list and only mounts what is on screen."))
                (block EdgeFeed
                  (takes Snapshot :as evt)
                  (gives Request)
                  (implements Durable)
                  (sketch "Draws the list and only mounts what is on screen."))
                (block BatchScheduler :type "Service"
                  (implements Observable)
                  (sketch "Keeps the latest state per key."))))
            (level
              (block BatchIndex
                (gives Snapshot :as emit)
                (sketch "Keeps the latest state per key."))
              (block RetrySearch
                (gives Snapshot :as emit)
                (implements Observable)
                (sketch "Draws the list and only mounts what is on screen."))
              (adjacent
                (block EdgeIndex
                  (gives Receipt :as done)
                  (implements Observable)
                  (sketch "Retries failed deliveries with backoff, then parks them for a human to look at."))
                (block EdgeMailer :type "Feature"
                  (takes Receipt :as evt)
                  (sketch "Retries failed deliveries with backoff, then parks them for a human to look at."))
                (block EdgeQueue
                  (sketch "Turns raw input into typed commands and rejects anything malformed before it reaches storage.")))))))))
  (level
    (block RetryFeed
      (takes Request)
      (gives Command :as emit)
      (implements Observable)
      (sketch "Draws the list and only mounts what is on screen."))
    (block Planner
      (takes Receipt)
      (sketch "Thin wrapper."))
    (adjacent
      (block LocalMetrics
        (takes Receipt)
        (sketch "Draws the list and only mounts what is on screen."))
      (block Sync
        (sketch "Turns raw input into typed commands and rejects anything malformed before it reaches storage.")))))
